messages:
elaine.ops: Quick update — the incident RCA is live: https://internal.redwood/rca/2923456789. TL;DR: autoscaler metric tagging dropped the region label under burst, so scale decisions were local-only in two regions. Rollback restored capacity but we had a ~25m impact window. Please review the doc and the action table. Ack by end of day if you own an item.

oncall-bot: Incident automated timeline: 12:04 deploy -> 12:11 latency climb -> 12:17 autoscaler errors (metric tag missing) -> 12:23 partial rollback -> 12:35 full rollback -> 12:48 service restored. Full logs attached in the RCA.

morgan.eng: Thanks @elaine.ops. I'll triage the autoscaler metric tests and add a regression job. Adding owners now.

sam.k: I'll take action 1 — "fix metric tagging in publish pipeline". Plan: add region tag invariant + unit test, run through staging autoscaler job. Target: Fri 2024-01-12 EOD. I'll open the PR and link here. :point_right: https://github.com/redwood/autoscaler/pull/

jamie.prod: Need a short customer-facing blurb for CSMs and sales. I can draft a one-paragraph summary and share by tomorrow morning. Who should I loop in for review?

devon.sre: I'll own action 2 — "canary + fallback verification". Steps: add a canary policy, simulate burst, validate fallback across regions, and add histogram alerts. Proposed checkpoint: Mon 2024-01-15 11:00 PT. Can folks confirm availability?

elaine.ops: Office hours to walk through RCA and clarify action items: Tue 2024-01-09 11:00 PT in #all-hands (virtual link in calendar). Please drop questions in-thread before then.

morgan.eng: Confirmed Monday checkpoint + attending Tue office hours.

sam.k: Confirmed. Will paste PR link here when ready.

jamie.prod: I'll draft the customer note and ping @sam.k for any technical accuracy checks.

devon.sre: Adding the regression job to CI and setting a daily watch for one week.

elaine.ops: Two quick asks: 1) owners, react with :white_check_mark: when you accept the action; 2) if you need runway changes, flag now so we can re-prioritize.

morgan.eng: ✅

sam.k: ✅ (will update ETA if anything slips)

jamie.prod: ✅

devon.sre: ✅

elaine.ops: Thanks team — we'll reconvene at the checkpoint and report back in this thread with PR links and verification notes. If anything urgent pops up, escalate in #eng-oncall.
